crossRefs.note: I didn’t sit in the assembly of those who make merry and rejoice. I sat alone because of your hand, for you have filled…
I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.
It is better to go to the house of mourning than to go to the house of feasting; for that is the end of all men, and…
In that day, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, called to weeping, to mourning, to baldness, and to dressing in sackcloth;
Who lie on beds of ivory, and stretch themselves on their couches, and eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves…
For as in those days which were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until…
They ate, they drank, they married, and they were given in marriage until the day that Noah entered into the ship, and…
But as it is, I wrote to you not to associate with anyone who is called a brother who is a sexual sinner, or covetous…
Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.

parallels.note: He made them a feast, and they ate and drank.

translations.web: “You shall not go into the house of feasting to sit with them, to eat and to drink.”
translations.bsb: You must not enter a house where there is feasting and sit down with them to eat and drink.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt not also go into the house of feasting, to sit with them to eat and to drink.
translations.asv: And thou shalt not go into the house of feasting to sit with them, to eat and to drink.
